creator.title: SCUTOONS Creator
creator.sign_in_text: Sign in with your email to open the creator editor.
creator.no_access_text: The creator editor is for SCUTOONS creators. Your account ({email}) doesn't have the creator role yet – ask an admin to add it.
creator.new_chapter_created: Chapter {number} created as a draft in every locale and added to the season. Save it to keep it.
creator.publish_confirm: Publish {file} ({locales})? Readers see it right away.
creator.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
creator.restore_confirm: Restore version #{id} as a new draft of {locale}?
creator.recover_stale: They were made on an older version.
creator.conflict: Someone saved a newer version of {locale} ({file}). Reload to get it, or overwrite it with yours.
creator.status_hint: Visibility in the reader, per language: published = listed and readable, draft = hidden, coming-soon = listed but not readable. Stored in {file} and saved with the chapter.
creator.status_not_in_season: not in the season (invalid – every chapter belongs to a season)
creator.status_sync: The chapter file's status follows the season on save.
creator.status_follow_chapters: Saving also updates the status in the chapter files (for older readers).
creator.season_missing: This toon has no season yet. Create season 1 (and toon.json if it is missing) as drafts in every language, then add chapters.
creator.orphans: Chapter files without a season: {numbers}. A chapter must always belong to a season – add them to {file}.
creator.not_loaded: The toon's files are not loaded yet. Reload the page and try again.
creator.chapters_adopted: Existing chapter files added to the season as draft: {numbers}.
creator.same_for_all_hint: Use the {locale} value in every language
creator.toon_missing: This toon has no toon.json yet – create season 1 on the toon page (it creates toon.json too).
creator.reader_uses_season: The reader shows the season title and description (plot) on the toon page, and the sequence status decides which chapters are listed / readable. Not shown anywhere in the reader yet: authors, number, release, language, cover (square/portrait) and credits – the credits page shows the toon's Credits (the Credits page) in the reader's language.
creator.reader_uses_toon: The reader shows title, description and cover.square on the toon page, map (terrain layer, size, center) in the map overlay, download.music / download.complete and title on the download page. Not used by the reader: id, authors, chapters, language, release, thumbnail, cover.portrait and status (listing uses the toon's index entry).
creator.format_hint: SCUTOONS slice: 390×625 px at 1x, 1170×1875 px at 3x – text-free art, the words are live text boxes.
creator.draw_hint: Drag on the image to draw a text box. Arrows nudge, Shift+arrows ×10, Delete removes.
creator.select_slice: Select a slice on the left.
creator.languages_hint: The source language is the one the toon is written in; the others are translations of it. Every editor of this toon (text boxes, missing translations, length warnings, VN events, new chapters) follows these settings.
creator.languages_unsaved: Save the draft to use the new languages in the editors.
creator.languages_remove_note: Removing a language keeps its files in the store; the editors just stop showing it.
creator.locale_files_created: {count} {locale} files created from {source} as drafts (not published).
creator.preview_hint: Newest drafts from the store, rendered like in the reader.
creator.preview_vn_note: Visual novel events are not played in the preview.
creator.preview_renderer_note: Horizontal groups are shown one below the other here.
creator.credits_open_hint: People and their roles – shown on the reader's credits page
creator.credits_deprecated: Moved to Credits – these season fields are no longer edited here and the reader never showed them. Edit the credits on the toon's Credits page.
creator.credits_move_hint: Drag, or focus and press ArrowUp / ArrowDown
creator.credits_lead_hint: Shown first and prominently on the credits page.
creator.credits_entries: Credits (grouped by role category on the page)
creator.credits_people_hint: {count} people in the shared registry (all toons).
creator.credits_merge_confirm: Merge “{from}” into “{to}”? {count} references in this toon are replaced; the name becomes an alias.
creator.credits_registry_hint: The registry is shared by every toon: changes show up in all credits after publishing.
creator.credits_custom_roles_hint: Only this toon uses them (saved in its credits.json).
creator.credits_vocabulary_hint: The role vocabulary of all toons (scutoons/_/roles.json).

login.network_error: Can't reach the SCUTOONS server. Try again later.
login.login_failed: That did not work. Check the code and try again.
login.login_intro: Sign in with your email. We send you a one-time code, no password.
login.code_sent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it here or tap the link in the mail.
login.no_account_hint: The creator is for existing accounts with the creator role. New accounts are created in the reader.
